summary: Implemented rich_measure for Tree and the new VerticalCenter in rich.align, plus the related Align and Console.print changes, CHANGELOG entry, and tests. Files changed: rich/tree.py (Tree.__rich_measure__, iterative with explicit stack and level counter), rich/align.py (Align width constraint, Align.__repr__, VerticalCenter class), rich/console.py (render options use justify="default"), CHANGELOG.md (9.8.0 marked unreleased, Added subsection), tests/test_align.py (repr, rendering, measurement tests), tests/test_tree.py (tree measurement test). Tests were NOT run, since the instructions prohibited running repository code; verification was by reading the code against the acceptance criteria. Nothing was committed.
